ITEM 1 | Small whole cherry tomatoes, glossy bright red with smooth skin, about 2-2.5 cm diameter, five to six pieces clustered in the center-lower area of the bowl, firm and round, slight sheen | 55
ITEM 2 | Diced cooked light-colored meat pieces, off-white to pale tan with some golden-brown edges, cut into roughly 1-1.5 cm cubes, firm with a slightly fibrous, flaky surface, dry-looking, scattered across the upper and middle of the bowl | 90
ITEM 3 | Dark purplish-black small whole olives or beans, glossy skin, about 1.5 cm long, three to four pieces near the lower right of the cluster, smooth and firm | 15
ITEM 4 | Thin orange shreds, bright orange, a few small fragments near the center among the meat cubes, appearing as finely cut strips about 2-3 cm long, slightly moist | 3
